clue.text: Doesn't win seat, getting upset in state of utter perplexity

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and thrown into disorder, so the letters of the first three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A candidate who fails to win a seat at an election is left upset and baffled.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'Doesn't' is ignored; its letters D, O, E, S, N, T join WIN and SEAT as the thirteen letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: someone at the end of their wits is completely baffled and has no idea what to do next.

clue.text: Chap turns up in new suit, gets big wave

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside the rearranged letters
new signals the letters of suit made into a fresh arrangement
in a down clue, turning up means reading the word from bottom to top, that is backwards

parts.note: a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A man appears in a new suit and is met by a huge wave, perhaps a surfer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chap' looks like the subject of the sentence and 'suit' like clothing, but the suit's letters are only fodder; 'turns up' works because this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym description: this is a huge sea wave caused by an undersea earthquake.

clue.text: Wriggly line that's seen on the map of Africa

definitions.text: seen on the map of Africa

indicators.note: something wriggly twists about, so the letters of line are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A wiggly line drawn on a map of Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's wriggly line on a map is also a fair picture of a river, so the clue is close to an all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: the great river running north through Egypt is the most prominent feature drawn on any map of that continent.

clue.text: Like NY's irregular silhouette?

indicators.note: irregular means not in proper order, so the letters of the first two words are disordered

explanation.surface: A question about whether New York's jagged outline is being described.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of LIKE, NY and S (from the possessive) rearrange; the whole clue also describes Manhattan's jagged outline of towers.
explanation.definitionFit: The outline of a city's buildings against the sky is its silhouette, and New York's is famously irregular.

clue.text: People coming from certain country pubs welcoming help standing up

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the pubs word holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: inns are pubs

indicators.note: in a down clue, standing up means the word reads upwards, that is backwards

parts.note: aid is help

explanation.surface: Visitors arrive from a rural area, and the pubs welcome them, offering help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'certain country' looks like rural land but means a particular nation; 'standing up' works as a reversal because this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Natives of a nation in South Asia are called by this name, so they are people from a specific country.

clue.text: Sort of posh business

indicators.note: sort is read as a verb, to sort or arrange, so the letters of posh are re-sorted

explanation.surface: A description of an upmarket kind of company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort of' looks like a vague qualifier for 'posh', but here sort means rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A retail business or trading concern is commonly called this, as in setting one up or talking shop.

clue.text: Note was upsetting but presenting little difficulty

indicators.note: upsetting means overturning, so the letters of the two words are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A message was distressing but caused no real trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal idiom saying a task is easy and causes no trouble or effort.

clue.text: Intrigue following explosive magazine article that was aimed at Parliament

definitions.text: magazine article that was aimed at Parliament

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the intrigue word comes after the explosive word

parts.note: gunpowder is an explosive
a plot is an intrigue or conspiracy

explanation.surface: A conspiracy inspired by an explosive magazine article attacking Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on 'magazine' as a store of powder: the 1605 conspiracy used barrels of it against the Houses of Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: Guy Fawkes and fellow conspirators planned in 1605 to blow up Parliament with barrels of explosive, an item kept in a magazine.

clue.text: Holy smoke, it could be responsible!

definitions.text: Holy smoke, it could be responsible!

parts.words: Holy smoke, it could be responsible!
parts.note: the exclamation of surprise is read literally: sacred smoke in a church comes from a vessel of smouldering aromatic resin

explanation.walkthrough: 'Holy smoke!' is an exclamation of surprise, but literally it is the fragrant smoke of church ritual, and the vessel holding it would be responsible.
explanation.definitionFit: A container for smouldering aromatic resin, used in religious ritual, produces sacred fumes in church services.

clue.text: American friend seen around university most of the time

indicators.note: seen around means placed on either side, so the American friend surrounds the single letter

parts.note: US is short for American, as in the US
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A friend from America is spotted near a campus.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: if something happens in most instances, it is the normal, customary case.

clue.text: Calls to return to paths of virtue?

definitions.meaning: calls in the sense of visits casually, pays a short unplanned visit

definitions.text: to return to paths of virtue?
definitions.meaning: read as two words, it says give up wrongdoing: abandon one's wickedness

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer 5,2 as 4,3 to see the second reading: drop sin, to stop sinning.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for visiting briefly and informally; split differently, it also means abandoning wrongdoing.

clue.text: Quiet place for entertainment

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
to lay is to place or set down

explanation.surface: A calm spot where people can be entertained.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama staged in a theatre is a form of entertainment.

clue.text: Last in in the river

indicators.note: the second in places the first one inside the river's name

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall, England

explanation.surface: Someone is the last one into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'in in' reads awkwardly: the first is the letters, the second the container signal. The Fal is a river in Cornwall, in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something that comes at the very end of a series is the closing or ultimate one.

clue.text: Present the woman's beginning to expect

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman, as in her coat

indicators.note: beginning to means the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A woman's present is the start of her expecting, perhaps a baby gift.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym for being in attendance: someone who is present is in this place.

clue.text: Ability that brings runner £50

parts.note: a ski is a runner, like the runner of a sledge
L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, and L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A talent that earns an athlete fifty pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' suggests an athlete but means a ski, a sliding runner; the pound sign and the 50 each give an L.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: expertise or competence at a task is an ability.

clue.text: Book of stamps?

parts.note: a stamp collector's book is the plain sense; the question mark hints at a record of stamping music too

explanation.walkthrough: A philatelist keeps stamps in a book of blank pages, and a collection of recorded tracks shares the name.
explanation.definitionFit: A book with blank pages for keeping stamps or photographs bears this name.

clue.text: Hint that reveals both experience and age

definitions.meaning: a useful tip or clever trick

definitions.text: that reveals both experience and age
definitions.meaning: a crease in the skin, which shows a face has lived long and seen much

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a clever tip or trick, and a line in the skin that comes with getting older.

clue.text: Shows rank subservience

parts.note: rank here is military rank, not utter: a soldier shows respect to a superior officer with a raised hand

explanation.walkthrough: 'rank subservience' reads as gross grovelling, but rank is military: deferring to a higher rank with a hand to the brow.
explanation.definitionFit: Military personnel raise a hand to the head as a formal mark of respect to a superior officer.

clue.text: Allowed to be clever in denouement

indicators.note: in places the clever word inside the word for the denouement

parts.note: the denouement is the end of a story
able means clever or capable

explanation.surface: Someone was permitted to show cleverness at a story's climax.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something permitted or made possible has been allowed.

clue.text: A group of musicians on leave

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians

explanation.surface: Some musicians are on leave, away from work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on leave' looks like a holiday phrase, but 'on' gives its letters and 'leave' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym verb: to desert or forsake someone is to leave them behind.

clue.text: Send me around Eastern land

indicators.note: around means turned about, so the letters of the two words are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A request to be sent on a tour of the East.
explanation.definitionFit: A historical term for an estate: land attached to a manor and kept by its owner.

clue.text: Stalks out of the kitchen garden

definitions.text: Stalks out of the kitchen garden

parts.words: Stalks out of the kitchen garden
parts.note: stalks looks like a verb, someone striding angrily out, but means plant stems grown in a vegetable patch

explanation.walkthrough: 'Stalks out' looks like someone storming off; it is the noun, the pink stems picked from a vegetable plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A vegetable-patch plant whose pink stems are cooked as a sweet, often in crumbles.

clue.text: Matter-of-fact doctrine is dividing kingdom

indicators.note: dividing means splitting apart, so the small word sits inside the kingdom word

parts.note: a realm is a kingdom

explanation.surface: A down-to-earth belief system is splitting a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A philosophy or artistic stance of representing things accurately and practically, without idealising them.

clue.text: Designate a quiet period

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
a period is a full stop, also called a point

explanation.surface: An instruction to mark out a time for silence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'period' suggests a span of time, but it is the punctuation mark, a full stop or point.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym verb: to name someone officially to a role is to designate them.

clue.text: Top dog, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak signals the dog word is said aloud, sounding like the answer; that the answer's letters also sit inside speak is a coincidence

parts.note: a peke is a Pekingese dog

explanation.surface: Someone is called the top dog, as the saying goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top dog' reads as one phrase, but 'Top' is the definition and 'dog' the breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: the highest point of a mountain or anything else is its top.

clue.text: Black mark that may be examined in the lab

definitions.meaning: a slur or stain on someone's reputation

definitions.text: that may be examined in the lab
definitions.meaning: a sample spread on a slide for microscope testing, such as a cervical test

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a slander staining a reputation, and a sample spread thinly on a slide for testing.

clue.text: After spring, run and box

indicators.note: after means the run letter comes following the spring word

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Seasonal training advice: once spring arrives, go jogging and boxing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the season but is a water source.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym verb: boxers practise by trading light blows with a training partner.

clue.text: Container for suit

definitions.meaning: a box or holder, as in a suitcase
a lawsuit, an action brought in court

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a box or holder for goods, and a legal action brought before a court.

clue.text: Hock for man on board

definitions.meaning: to hock is to pledge goods at a pawnbroker for a loan
the least valuable chess piece, a foot soldier on the chessboard

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to pledge goods for a loan, and the lowliest piece in chess.

clue.text: Trials or evidence of plea bargaining

parts.note: deals are agreements struck between prosecution and defence in plea bargaining

explanation.surface: Court cases, or signs that defendants have struck bargains with prosecutors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trials' suggests court hearings, matching the legal surface, but means hard tests of endurance.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: severe tests of character or endurance are trials.

clue.text: Fancy silver in one place of gold, perhaps

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in places the silver symbol inside the other two pieces

parts.note: a mine is a place where gold may be dug
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A decorative silver piece set into gold jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' looks like an adjective for ornate silverwork but is a verb, to picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym verb: to fancy something is to suppose or picture it in the mind.

clue.text: Silly Enid, stop being vague

indicators.note: silly suggests the name is muddled, so its letters are jumbled

parts.note: to terminate is to stop

explanation.surface: Telling a woman named Enid to stop being so foolishly unclear.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something not fixed or precisely defined is vague.
